title: Only a Type of Spear│只有一種矛
description: The spear is now considered a rare weapon, similar to the trident and mace.│矛現在和三叉戟與重錘類似，被視為稀有武器。
body:
# Function│功能
- There is currently only one type of spear, which can be crafted using two sticks and a spearhead. Its attack attributes are the same as the Netherite Spear, and its durability and appearance are the same as the Iron Spear.│矛現在只有一種，用兩個木棒和一個矛頭可以合成。攻擊屬性與下界合金矛相同，耐久度與外觀與鐵矛相同。
- Copper, Stone, Iron, and Diamond Spear loot will no longer be generated in any reward chests.│所有獎勵箱中的銅、石、鐵、鑽石矛戰利品不再生成。
- The piglins that used to carry golden spears and the zombie piglins now carry golden swords.│攜帶金矛的豬布林和殭屍化豬布林改為攜帶金劍。
- The spearhead can be obtained from reward chests in certain structures, as detailed below.│矛頭可以從部分結構的獎勵箱中取得，具體內容如下。‎
<details>
<summary>Loot│戰利品</summary>

|-|-|-|-|-|-|
|Big Ocean Ruins│大型海底廢墟|Spearhead│矛頭|1|¹/₂₄|4.17%|1×|
|Small Ocean Ruins│小型海底廢墟|Spearhead│矛頭|1|¹/₁₃|7.69%|1×|
|Bastion Remnant (Treasure Room)│堡壘遺跡（藏寶室）|Spearhead│矛頭|1|¹²/₁₁₂|10.71%|3×|
|End City│末地城|Spearhead│矛頭|1|⁶/₉₂|6.52%|2-6×|
|Buried Treasure│埋藏的寶藏|Spearhead│矛頭|1|¹/₃|7.69%|0-1×|
</details>
